Operator Guide • v0.17.0 • Multi-Leg Splitter & Receipts Engine

IronLedger Operator Guide & Reference

IronLedger is a local-first financial OS. Plaintext Beancount is accounting authority; SQLite is a disposable projection. Phase 17 introduces automated multi-leg order splitting for e-commerce receipts (Amazon, Venmo, Apple, Uber) forwarded from multiple email accounts via Sigil Relay with 3-tier categorization and strict zero-float integer balance guarantees (∑ minor_units = 0).

v0.17.0 Architecture Highlights

  • Multi-Account Forwarded Email Unwrapping: Automatically un-wraps forwarded email receipts (.eml) from Gmail, Outlook/Hotmail, Apple Mail/iCloud, and Resent headers to extract original merchant, purchase timestamp, and line items.
  • Amazon & Venmo Normalizers: Groups multi-item order histories, tax lines, shipping fees, and discounts into structured itemized orders.
  • 3-Tier Categorization Engine: Resolves line items through Deterministic Rules (95% conf) → Keyword Taxonomy Heuristic (85% conf) → Expenses:Uncategorized fallback (50% conf).
  • Multi-Leg Compiler Contract: Upgraded compiler to support 1 imported parent posting + N ≥ 1 contra postings with exact integer balance verification.
  • MCP & Web Workbench Workflows: Preview proposals via preview_order_split and confirm splits via confirm_order_split or Workbench REST API.
Milestones: v0.17.0 Multi-Leg Splits • v0.16.0 Anomaly Engine • v0.15.0 Inbox Attach + PDF Wedge • v0.14.0 IRS Tax Lots
Diataxis 1

Quickstart Tutorial

1. Ingest Statement Records

Import credit card or bank statements (OFX, QFX, CSV, or text-layer PDF). These create parent staged transactions (e.g. AMEX charge of -$54.10).

python -m ironledger.cli import inbox/amex_statement.ofx --confirm "import inbox/amex_statement.ofx"

2. Forward Purchase Receipts via Email

Set forwarding rules in Hotmail, Apple Mail, Outlook, or Gmail to forward order confirmations to Sigil. The email receipt engine un-wraps headers to extract original items.

3. Ingest Amazon / Venmo Order CSVs

Import Amazon Order History or Venmo statements. IronLedger automatically categorizes items and finds matching parent charges in staging.

4. Preview & Confirm Splits

Inspect split proposals in the Operator Workbench or via MCP tools. Confirming a proposal breaks down the single contra leg into itemized expenses.

# Preview via MCP or Web
GET /api/staging/splits/proposals
POST /api/staging/splits/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirm

5. Compile Multi-Leg Ledger

Compile approved staged transactions into plaintext Beancount with verified integer balance.

python -m ironledger.cli compile --confirm "authorize compile"
Diataxis 2

How-To Guides

How Multi-Leg Order Splitting Works

  • Lump-Sum Parent Charge: Credit card or checking account imports show a single lump sum (e.g. -$105.00 to Liabilities:CreditCard).
  • Itemized Order Ingest: When an Amazon order CSV or forwarded email receipt is ingested, IronLedger breaks the purchase into item lines (e.g. $35.00 Books, $50.00 Electronics, $20.00 Household).
  • Split Proposal: The system matches candidate charges within ±3 days and exact integer minor units, creating a split_proposals record.
  • Atomic Confirmation: Confirming the proposal mutates staged_postings to keep the 1 imported leg (-$105.00) and replace the single contra leg with 3 categorized contra postings (+35.00, +50.00, +20.00). Total balance remains exactly zero.

How to Set Up Multi-Account Forwarding via Sigil Relay

  • Forwarding Rules: In your email providers (Hotmail/Outlook, Apple Mail/iCloud, Gmail, Work accounts), create forwarding rules:
    • Subject contains: Order Confirmation, Receipt, Your receipt from Apple, Invoice
    • Action: Forward to your local Sigil Relay inbox address.
  • Envelope Unwrapping: The email receipt engine strips outer forwarding headers (---------- Forwarded message ---------, -----Original Message-----, Begin forwarded message:, Resent-From) to restore original merchant headers and dates.
  • Evidence Preservation: The original raw .eml is stored under source_documents as immutable accounting evidence.

How to Track Recurring Subscriptions & Price Jumps

IronLedger uses view v_recurring_subscriptions to detect cadences (WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, ANNUAL) and identify price jumps without floating-point math.

GET /api/analytics/subscriptions
GET /api/analytics/subscriptions/price-jumps

How to Attach PDF Statements & Later Evidence

Attach proposals match later statement rows to existing economic events. Ingest PDF statements with --pdf-profile. Confirm attach writes event_evidence without creating duplicate postings (no-op on attach compilation).

# Import with PDF Profile
python -m ironledger.cli import statement.pdf --pdf-profile chase_checking --confirm "import statement.pdf"

# Inspect & Confirm Attach via API
GET /api/staging/proposals
POST /api/staging/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirm
# Headers: X-IronLedger-Op-Token: <token>
# CLI: python -m ironledger.cli attach-confirm <proposal_id>

How to Manage Multi-Asset Holdings & Watchlist Pricing

Manage commodities, cost basis tax lots (FIFO/LIFO/HIFO), and mark-to-market valuations in Holdings & Watchlist.

How to Inspect Cash Flow Sankey Diagrams

Renders directed cash flow linkages from Income accounts through Operating Buffer to Expenses and Asset allocations for any YYYY-MM period.

How to Generate and Verify Compliance Audit Bundles

python -m ironledger.cli compliance generate --ledger-id default --framework SOC2_TYPE2 --out bundle.tar
python -m ironledger.cli compliance verify --bundle bundle.tar

Diataxis 4

Architecture & Invariants

Multi-Leg Posting Contract

A valid staged transaction must possess exactly 1 imported leg (the account where money was withdrawn or credited) and N ≥ 1 contra legs (categorized expense or asset postings). The sum of minor units across all legs must equal zero for the same currency before approval or compilation.

3-Tier Item Categorization Hierarchy

Order line items are classified progressively: (1) Exact & regex review rules from categorization_rules at 95% confidence; (2) Pre-compiled keyword taxonomy across Books, Electronics, Food, Household, Transport, and Software at 85% confidence; (3) Fallback to Expenses:Uncategorized at 50% confidence.

Email Header & Envelope Unwrapping

Forwarded RFC 822 messages contain intermediate transmission headers. The email engine strips forwarding blocks to restore original merchant, purchase timestamp, and line items while retaining the full raw envelope in source_documents for cryptographic provenance.

Zero-Float Exact Integer Arithmetic

Enforced by static AST verification: zero ast.Div and zero runtime import beancount across all modules. Currency values are stored strictly as integer cents (minor units) with integer scale multiplication and division.
